title: Universe screen live-call authorization (v0.3, long 429 backoff)
description: Per-run authorization for the ADR-117 authoritative screen successor. It binds everything the v0.2 grant binds - the V5 source-minimal prompt bytes, the packet cohort, the selection, the enablement, the client contract, the route, the budgets and the model-evidence circuit breaker - and adds the screen's own generate-attempt policy as a bound field rather than an assumption. screen_generate_retry_policy_version, generate_attempt_cap_per_row and external_requests_per_row are consts: a grant minted for the committed three-attempt extraction policy cannot be executed by this route, and a grant minted for this route cannot be executed by the v0.1 or v0.2 runners, whose own contract consts differ. The runtime arithmetic is relational and re-derived at preflight: provider_attempt_cap equals logical_request_cap times five, and budget_max_external_requests equals logical_request_cap times six (one countTokens send plus the five-attempt generate ceiling). No production cohort size is pinned here; only the canary case is fixed by const, because a canary is a stated hundred rows by definition. Runtime-only: this artifact is never committed to source control.

logical_request_cap.description: One logical request per selected valid packet, exactly. Stated, never discovered.

provider_attempt_cap.description: logical_request_cap times the five-attempt generate ceiling of the screen policy. Re-derived and re-checked at preflight.

budget_max_external_requests.description: logical_request_cap times six: one countTokens send plus the five-attempt generate ceiling per row.

retry_policy_version.description: The committed extraction transport policy, still named and still unchanged: it continues to govern timeouts and the declared transient conditions.

screen_generate_retry_policy_version.description: The screen's own generate-attempt policy. Pinned by const so a three-attempt grant cannot run here and this grant cannot run on a three-attempt route.

generate_attempt_cap_per_row.description: Five total attempts per logical packet: the original send plus four retries at 15s, 30s, 60s and 120s.

external_requests_per_row.description: One countTokens send, which is never retried, plus the five-attempt generate ceiling.

max_model_evidence_unverified.description: The ADR-116 model-evidence circuit breaker, carried forward unchanged: model-content failures are recorded, provider, governance, capture, cap and budget faults stay run-fatal.
